limitations: These are original generated 2D interpretations guided by the documented references, not extracted Sega backgrounds or certified 1:1 reproductions.
The new two locations do not imply complete saga-level coverage, alternate routes or fully recreated source stages.
The train main references are contributed Dreamcast captures, so arcade-version layout equivalence is not asserted.
The prescribed center allows alpha 0 or 1; some antialias residual alpha1 remains in the middle-plane images.
Registration, story routing, executable QA and PR publication belong to the parent task.
pixel_postprocessing: None. Final PNG files are exact copies of selected ImageGen outputs; Pillow used only for metadata and alpha analysis.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full opaque backplate for a side-view 2D fighting arena, one 16:9 landscape PNG, native 1600x900 requested.
Input image1 is the actual Zombie Revenge train-roof gameplay reference: preserve the identifiable weathered silver/green railway carriage roof, segmented metal sheets, long raised grated maintenance walkway and warm ochre railway tunnel with repeating ribs and horizontal utility conduits. Remove every character and all game HUD. Input image2 is ONLY the existing project's painting/material quality and fighting-arena layout reference; do not copy its fairground, moon, water, tents or decorative picture-frame border.
Primary request: adapt the TRAIN ROOF INSIDE THE TUNNEL into a readable side-on 2D fighting stage. A long, broad carriage roof crosses the ENTIRE bottom width horizontally, with a continuous flat playable strip at about81.6% of canvas height, empty from left to right. Show riveted roof panels and the shallow service grating running horizontally rather than toward a vanishing point. The ochre tunnel wall rises behind the roof, with its curved ceiling/ribs and old dark cable conduits; recesses suggest rail travel in the upper background. Keep the train's functional shapes grounded in image1. No platform station, no street or factory floor.
Composition: camera perpendicular to the fighting line, wide and restrained perspective, clear lateral arena. Roof starts about73% of image height, foot contact line at81.6%, and train roof/shoulder continues to the bottom edge. Small repeated details stay behind the fight area, no tall obstacle in the middle. Across x12.5%–87.5% and y20%–79%, retain moderate detail and clear silhouettes for later overlaid fighters. No deep central vanishing-point walkway that would imply walking away from camera.
Style: match image2's high-quality painted 2D videogame background, tangible aged metal and mineral surfaces, subtle illustrative grain, warm dim amber tunnel lamps over cool olive-gray train roof, believable atmospheric depth. A production game background, not a concept sheet.
Constraints: no people, zombies, silhouettes, bodies, creature faces, guns, UI, numbers, lettering, logos, labels, watermarks, border, panels, screenshot frame or motion blur. Entire image opaque, no transparency. Preserve the supplied reference's setting identity while making an original 2D arena adaptation; no claim of exact original camera reproduction.

Restrained orange light in deeper wall recesses, as in the source. Keep exposed industrial panels and fixtures identifiable, not a fantasy cave. Do not invent props unrelated to the supplied source.

No floor holes, bodies, piles, viscera, furniture or large obstacles in this lower strip. Camera perpendicular to the fighting line, a wide wall panorama with shallow depth; no central corridor rushing into the distance. Central x12.5%–87.5%,y20%–79% keeps its dark middle values and clear space so later characters read well. Most heavy organic shapes rise at side margins and overhead, moderate growth across rear wall.
Style: same detailed painted 2D videogame environment quality as image2, aged real materials, restrained cinematic exploitation-film grain, warm rusty orange versus gray-green metal. Source-guided spatial adaptation with consistent scale to the project.
Constraints: no characters, people, zombies, cows, creatures, recognizable body parts, carcasses, guns, text, logos, HUD, reticles, numbers, signs, interface, watermarks, picture border, panels, or cutout areas. Entire image opaque. One empty environment only, no title or claim of exact original layout.
